passages.context: The corrected commentary names GA 01, 03, and 0274 for omission and describes the longer reading as coherent and supported by the rest of the collated Greek witnesses. It records the majority editorial preference for omission and the Strutwolf-Wachtel minority preference for the addition, while the published split guiding line preserves both alternatives as equal-weight initial-text candidates. The same dated response records that GA 706 was corrected from omission to addition after inspection of its image.
